title: red
summary: Red, rouge, rosso: can different sounds hide a family connection?
question: Are red, rouge and rosso related?
completion: Red follows Old English rēad. French rouge and Italian rosso follow Latin words. They are distant relatives from an older colour-word family, not a chain of modern borrowings.
partner: A familiar word can carry a surprising history. Follow the evidence!
